turns.text: Good afternoon. This is Meera, a consultant with Divyaashree Developers. I'm calling about Whispers of the Wind, our private-valley villa-plot community near Nundhee Hills. Do you have a couple of minutes to speak?
Yes, I can talk for a few minutes. What is this regarding?
Understood, thank you. It's a private briefing on villa plots in Nundhee Valley. May I ask — were you looking at this more as a weekend home for yourself, or as an investment holding?
Weekend home. We live in Indiranagar and wanted somewhere we can drive out to on Friday evening.

Perfect. A second home in the hills is exactly how many of our families use it. And the Nundhee Hills, Devanahalli corridor — is that a geography you are comfortable with, rather than a central Bengaluru address?
Yes, we've driven up to Nundhee Hills several times. The air is the point, not being next to the office.
That makes sense. On fitment — plots here begin at ninety-two point four lakh, going up to about two point four six crore, and that is inclusive of taxes. Is that the band you were considering?
Around a crore to a crore and a half is comfortable for us.

Understood. That sits well inside the community. One last checkpoint — this is an ongoing, phased project, with possession around December twenty twenty-nine. Are you comfortable holding through that horizon while the valley comes up?
If the land and the master plan are right, twenty twenty-nine is fine. We are not in a rush to build tomorrow.

Appreciate you sharing that. Whispers of the Wind is designed as a private valley rather than a typical layout. About seventy-four percent of the land stays open — eco-parks, walking greens, and long hill views. At the heart is a twenty-thousand square-foot clubhouse. Plots run from twelve hundred to about thirty-two hundred square feet, so the homes sit in landscape, not on top of each other.
That density is what I care about. I don't want another gated grid.

Then you are looking at the right idea. If it suits you, I will have a property expert call you for a private briefing — no obligation — so you can see inventory in that one-crore band. What time works over the next day or two?
Tomorrow evening after seven. My name is Arjun Menon, this number is fine.
Perfect, Arjun. I will place you with an expert tomorrow after seven. Thank you for your time — I hope the valley feels like the weekend home you had in mind. I'll let you go.
